versions.subject: feat: update clickonce rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\dfsvc.exe'
    Initiated: 'true'
filter_main_known_ports:
    DestinationPort:
        - 80
        - 443
        - 445
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*

versions.subject: Merge PR #4702 from @nasbench - Rule tuning and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|contains: ':\Windows\Microsoft.NET\'
    Image|endswith: '\dfsvc.exe'
    Initiated: 'true'
filter_main_known_ports:
    DestinationPort:
        - 80
        - 443
filter_optional_dns_ipv6:
    # Based on VT. More than 140 binaries made communication over DNS
    DestinationIsIpv6: 'true'
    DestinationPort: 53
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: Image="*:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\*" Image="*\\dfsvc.exe" Initiated="true" NOT (DestinationPort IN (80, 443)) NOT (DestinationIsIpv6="true" DestinationPort=53)
